limitations: Exact identity binds literal internalNpcName only; normalized filename is discovery only.
Price presence in vendor code does not establish current Tibia Global parity.
Callbacks, external helpers, quest guards and full runtime are not evaluated; row-level storage fields are preserved.
No static match is not proof of runtime absence.
parser: Static braces/comment/string aware; literal integer clientId/clientid and buy/sell in npcConfig.shop or itemsTable only; no Lua evaluation. Nullable literal count/subType/subtype and original rows preserved. Byte offsets are zero based; lines one based.
